cohort: 395 fetuses (185 with CHD, 132 high-risk without CHD, 78 low-risk without CHD)
finding: Fetuses with CHD had a higher rate of abnormal CTG, emergency cesarean section, and Apgar scores ≤7, suggesting CHD itself is associated with intrapartum complications and may influence CTG interpretation.
mod_finding: While not a primary focus, the study found a higher rate of emergency cesarean section in fetuses with CHD and abnormal CTG, highlighting the potential influence of CTG interpretation on mode of delivery in this population.
